Charming Updated Home in West End Park – Walk to Vanderbilt & Centennial Park

Stay in the heart of Nashville’s West End Park neighborhood in this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home. Perfect for couples, small families, or business travelers, this space blends modern comfort with classic charm.

Inside, you’ll find a bright, stylish living area, a fully equipped kitchen with updated appliances, and two cozy bedrooms designed for restful nights. The main bathroom features fresh finishes, and the additional half-bath adds extra convenience.

Step outside to your private, fenced backyard – perfect for morning coffee or evening wine under the Tennessee sky.

Located just minutes from Vanderbilt University, Centennial Park, The Parthenon, and Nashville’s best dining and nightlife, you’ll have the city’s highlights right at your doorstep.

Amenities include:
	•	High-speed Wi-Fi
	•	Smart TV
	•	In-unit washer & dryer
	•	Free parking
	•	Self check-in

Whether you’re here for a weekend getaway, work trip, or extended stay, this West End Park gem is your perfect Nashville home base.
